newsitem.title: USA: N. Calif. rail project prepares to award contract.
newsitem.headline: N. Calif. rail project prepares to award contract.

text.p: The Bay Area Rapid Transit District (BART) said on Tuesday it plans to advertise the first construction contract for its massive San Francisco International Airport extension project.

BART Board President Dan Richard said builders throughout the country were expected to compete for work on the multi-contract, $1.2 billion project. Richard said BART's goal was to break ground before the end of this calendar year.
The first contract, valued at about $15 million, calls for relocation of public utilities along the length of the extension, which runs about 8.2 miles.
BART said the first contract will be awarded following the receipt of an agreement from the Federal Transit Administration for the $750 million federal share of the project.
